sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:46

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 16:46:1
items.html: ZA was in the secret of Neshama, which is Bina, and his Nukva was in the secret of Ruach, which is ZA, etc. and it is called Neshama, because ZA was above, in the place of Bina, etc., and it is called Ruach, because then his Nukva was in the place of her husband, ZA. This is perplexing, for he seemingly contradicts his own words within the same passage: above he says that ZON rose up into the palace of Aba and Ima, and likewise below in this part, item 57, whereas here he says that ZA rose to the place of Bina and the Nukva to the place of ZA. The thing is that what is spoken of here is the ZA and Nukva that remained below, clothed in the worlds of Yetzira and Beria. For when ZA is clothed in the world of Beria, he must bestow upon it from Bina of Atzilut, since Beria receives only from Bina, for it is the discernment of the Bina of the Guf [body], and a discernment receives only from the discernment corresponding to it in the upper one. And this is what he says, that it is called “Neshama, because ZA was above, in the place of Bina”: that is, he bestows upon Beria by receiving the light above, from the place of Bina, which is the discernment corresponding to Beria. And this is what he says, “and it is called Ruach, because then his Nukva was in the place of ZA”: for the Nukva that is clothed in the world of Yetzira cannot bestow upon Yetzira except from the light of ZA, which is attributed to the discernment of Yetzira, and for its sake she must be in the place of ZA in order to bestow upon Yetzira; therefore the light is named after ZA, which is Ruach. However, ZON themselves are higher in degree, for the Nukva is in the place of Ima, which is YESHSUT, and ZA is in the place of Aba, which is the upper AVI, as above; and see well above, in the adjacent item.
